_about: Independent reference for how long each food keeps (days, [low, high]) in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Compiled blind (without seeing the app figures) from USDA FoodKeeper, the FDA Refrigerator & Freezer Storage Chart and FSIS guidance, in two separate passes. Conventions: produce, meat and fish as bought; cartons, jars and bottles opened; canned goods unopened in the pantry and opened in the fridge; dry goods opened; leftovers cooked; freezer figures for best quality. [0, 0] means it should not be kept there, or that doing so is pointless. Checked by __tests__/shelflife-reference.test.ts.

2% milk.note: FDA chart: milk ~7 days fridge (opened 4-7 days), freezer up to 3 mo; must be refrigerated

Almond butter.note: Natural nut butter: opened ~1-3 months pantry, 3-6 months fridge. Guidance thin

Almond milk.note: Opened: fridge 7-10 days (brand guidance); opened must be refrigerated; manufacturers advise against freezing (separates), usable for cooking ~1-3 mo

Almonds.note: Shelled almonds: ~3-6 months pantry once opened, 6-12 months fridge, 1-2 years freezer

Apple pie.note: USDA-style: baked fruit pie 1-2 days room temp, then 2-4 days fridge; freezer ~2-4 months. Freezer guidance varies

Apples.note: FoodKeeper: counter ~3 wk, fridge 4-8 wk; freezer (sliced/cooked) ~8 mo

Artichokes.note: Fridge ~4-7 days; cooked hearts frozen 8-12 mo

Asparagus.note: FoodKeeper: fridge 3-4 days; blanched frozen 8-12 mo

Aubergine.note: FoodKeeper-style: fridge 4-7 days; cooked/blanched frozen 6-8 mo

Beets.note: Tops removed: fridge 1-3 wk; cooked frozen 6-8 mo

Bell peppers.note: Fridge ~1-2 wk (green longer than red/yellow); chopped frozen 6-8 mo
